experiences.description: Responsible for building the services and PMO practice for Beyond IT's RPA practice

Managed the global presales organization.

Lead the day to day interaction and strategy of presales with our clients, sales, delivery organizations and marketing.  Worked to strategize the right mix of skills and talent for sales opportunities while ensuring we moved to the trusted advisor role with each client.

Managed the Operations, Vendor Management and PMO

Worked with the Operations and contract team to ensure alignment and proper prioritization of contract creation and staff scheduling for the services organization.  Worked with the PMO to create proper intellectual property on all completed projects while establishing a proper PM framework for our clients.

Sr Service Manager for the Great Lakes Territory for Services.

Worked with sales and OEM's and presales to strategize, negotiate and win services and hardware deals.  Worked with strategic enterprise clients to properly staff projects and resolved any client satisfaction issues.  Also created and lead 3 national services team around Stadium Vision, Connected stadium and Video teleconferencing.

Managed the West Michigan Services Team.

Managed and led the West Michigan Professional services team while also strategizing with the sales team on how to win and grow services and hardware deals.  Staff planning and forecasting with the PMO and resource team was critical to the success of client engagement.

Elected as the Vice President of the board for this non profit organization.

Served on the board of directors and over sought the technical needs and direction of the building.  Including a technology classroom used for the home school community.

Created alignment between the Business and IT.

Ensured that the IT direction was in alignment and meeting the goals of the business during the explosive growth of the title industry.  Created a hosted solution to allow the organization to quickly ramp and scale as needed.  Allowing the organization to quickly become a nationally recognized leader with top 10 lending institutes.

VP and Director of IT Operations for North America

Lead the operations for all of IT in North America while ensuring the infrastructure was in alignment with the growing needs of the business.  While maintaining a standardized office configuration allowing for scale and growth.

Lead development and implementation of call center applications resulting in 80% decrease in call center cost through automation, Artificial intelligence and case base reasoning tools.  Reduced abandon rate to <1%, wait time <30 seconds and turned a 36 month ROI into a 12 month ROI.
Implemented a global CRM system with over 1,200 users in multiple call centers.

Received award from Nortel Networks on the global implementation of a CRM system for over 1,200 users
